crossRefs.note: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
We all roar like bears and moan bitterly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is…

translations.web: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
translations.bsb: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
translations.kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
translations.asv: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
